description.value: Wildside Pizzeria is a pizza and fast-food spot located on Main Street in Radium Hot Springs, a gateway community to Kootenay National Park. They offer a broad menu of customizable pizzas, donair pitas, salads, and chicken wings available for pickup with online ordering. Touring cyclists heading in or out of the Rockies will find a full hot-food option with a loyalty rewards program.

address.value: 7533 Main Street West, Radium Hot Springs, BC
